featured_reviews.name: omkar samant
featured_reviews.review_text:
5 stars for a Car Wash ??

Well yes.

This is the only place I go to.
Its not like a 3M. But its good. They do the same things at penny costs and they can do quick work.

Plus points.
1. Low cost. 70₹ for wash. 150 for outside and inside. 300 for wash with soap, outside, inside, mats and anything else you want.
2. If you have a car vaccum of your own, they will do it for you.
3. They can do more than 7 cars and 5 bikes at the same time. So waiting time is hardly 5 mins. If at all.
4. Cleaners are pretty obedient, they will do everything you want and the way you want it.
5. Ask for Rahul. He is good and he is quick.

Shortcomings:
1. The soap they use is not really car friends if you have new polish.
Bring your own. Or do it if only required.
2. They dont offer vacuuming services if not asked.
3. No underbody cleaning available. Its a road side shop.
4. Well its a road side place so,….

In any case. Its my fav place to have my beloved car cleaned.

featured_reviews.name: Shubham Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this place because I had heard good reviews about 3M. Unfortunately, my experience was extremely disappointing.

I got a detailed car wash done for my Virtus after a Konkan trip (and if you’re from Konkan, you know how stubborn that red soil can be). I received a call in the evening saying the car was ready. From a distance, it looked great — almost like a brand new car. But that impression lasted only a few seconds.

As soon as I inspected it closely, I realized the job was far from complete. The cleaning was poorly done, with multiple spots clearly missed. I’ve attached pictures of the “great work” done by the team — honestly, I could have done a better job at home.

Paying ₹1800 for this level of service is unacceptable. For a brand like 3M, this was nowhere close to expectations. Definitely not worth your hard-earned money — I would strongly suggest looking for better options nearby if you genuinely care about your car.

To be fair, I did call the store manager, Mr. Yamin, the next day (he had already left when I picked up the car). He was courteous and asked me to bring the car back for a rework. But honestly, what’s the point of spending more time and fuel to fix something that should have been done right the first time?

What really got me was when I was pointing out the missed spots, one of the staff casually asked, “Sir aur kahin gandi dikh rahi hai car?” — I mean, if I have to find and point out every issue, I might as well wash the car myself.

PLEASE STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE and save your money. 3M products may be premium, but the service here certainly isn’t. I was even considering getting my roof blackened here, but after this experience, I’d much rather spend my money elsewhere.

The staff was incredibly knowledgeable and attentive, ensuring every inch of my car was treated with care. The graphene coating has not only enhanced the appearance of my car but also provided long-lasting protection against the elements. I will definitely recommend The Car Spa service and expertise in car detailing.

featured_reviews.name: Abhijat Dave
featured_reviews.review_text:
Got full car PPF, 3M CR70 film on all glasses & 7D carpets done today in my brand new Hycross.  Manish & his team did a great job on all jobs.  Manish explained me very patiently about various options in PPF & helped me choose the right product.  He offered me 3M CR70 films on all car windows including windshield at most competitive rates amongst 10+ vendors I’d inquired.  I was told that there are many counterfeit products available for CR70, so he made sure that the film is tested with a meter confirming 70% heat & 99% UV
reduction.  Overall, I found Manish to be an honest and a valued consultant  offering car shining services & high quality accessories at the most reasonable prices.  I’ll highly recommend Car Spa, Borivali for car detailing, maintenance & accessories.

featured_reviews.name: Nitin Mendon
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited for car wash assuming it will take not more than 30 mins, however looking at the condition was suggested for a thorough internal cleaning which would take 3hrs approx. When I saw the car realised how much that time was critical and much required. The staff very well mannered and Manish was great in explaining me the details. They also offered to drop the car back home. Had a great experience, must visit in case you want good professional service
